_doc: shots10 demo: three timing QTEs per turn at the Entry / Apex / Exit camera stops. Corner 1: Entry 0.92, Apex deliberately UNPLAYED (cursor runs past the zone -> 0), Exit 0.55 -> raw_qte = mean = 0.49. Corner 2: 0.60 / 0.90 / 0.75. Same picks and seed as shots9 (player passes in corner 1, rival re-passes in corner 2). Scores are submitted exactly (parity); the cursor stops where each score sits.
